hypothesis: analytics.payments is not backward compatible with v4: it lacks risk_score, so jdbc-payments-sink fails every insert and errors.tolerance=all sends the records to the DLQ.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis gives the ground-truth cause: the warehouse table lacks risk_score, so the JDBC sink fails every insert, and errors.tolerance=all sends the records to the DLQ. It places both the first failure and the root cause at the sink connector in kafka-connect.
